correctness.rationale: Exact edge enumeration for the 12-vertex regular truncation gives 18 edges and section crossing formula N=4+a+b+c+d-2ab. The global normal symmetry reduces to a 1/48-sphere chamber. Exact rational clipping of four sign lines yields all six positive-area cells; their vertex counts are enumerated in the proof. Two spherical triangle determinant computations yield p4, and the independent 18-edge angle sum yields the expectation and thus p5,p6. The computations are reproduced from self-contained package code but the infinite statement follows from explicit exhaustive symbolic inequalities, not tests.

value.rationale: The central-section polygon-type distribution is a canonical stochastic-geometric invariant for an Archimedean solid. The three exact positive masses and complete angular classification sharpen mere existence/generic support and the simple first moment; the arctangent radicals quantify a nontrivial spherical subdivision and supply sharp benchmarks for random-section geometry. The specification is neither an arbitrary slice nor a routine rescaling of a known general formula.
